delete.message:
Your account will be permanently deleted after 7 days. Everything you created (letters you wrote, photos you uploaded, special days you added, your diary) will be deleted. Your partner's account and what they created stay. Your star and its planets will be deleted. If you bought Premium, it also ends for your partner.

Deleting your account does not cancel your subscription; cancel it separately in the App Store or Google Play.

ursa_major.description: With the Big Dipper, formed by seven bright stars, it is the guide of the northern sky.
ursa_major.mythology: The eternal pointer that helps you find the North Star.

cassiopeia.name: Queen Sector
cassiopeia.description: The queen constellation that shines in the sky with its distinctive W shape.
cassiopeia.mythology: The legendary Queen of Ethiopia who boasted of her beauty.

cygnus.name: Swan Sector
cygnus.description: The graceful Swan beating its wings along the Milky Way.
cygnus.mythology: A symbol of fidelity, also known as the Northern Cross.

taurus.name: Bull Sector
taurus.description: The ancient Bull constellation, ablaze with the red fire of Aldebaran.
taurus.mythology: The sky's reflection of the white bull Zeus became when he carried off Europa.

gemini.name: Twins Sector
gemini.description: A symbol of brotherhood in the sky, with the twin stars Castor and Pollux.
gemini.mythology: Inseparable twins — one mortal, one divine.

aries.name: Ram Sector
aries.description: The ancient gate of the spring equinox and keeper of the Golden Fleece.
aries.mythology: The ram who bore the legendary Golden Fleece sought by Jason and the Argonauts.

cancer.name: Crab Sector
cancer.description: The simplest yet most mysterious corner of the sky, it hosts the Beehive Cluster.
cancer.mythology: The small but brave crab who battled Hercules.

leo.name: Lion Sector
leo.description: The king of the sky, crowned by the blue light of Regulus.
leo.mythology: The Nemean Lion — Hercules' first and hardest labor.

virgo.name: Maiden Sector
virgo.description: The goddess of fertility, shining with the star Spica, and home to galaxy clusters.
virgo.mythology: Herald of the harvest season, goddess of abundance and justice.

libra.name: Scales Sector
libra.description: The symbol of justice and balance in the sky.
libra.mythology: The scales of justice Astraea left behind when she abandoned the world.

scorpius.name: Scorpion Sector
scorpius.description: The sky's most dangerous hunter, beating with the red heart of Antares.
scorpius.mythology: The legendary scorpion that killed Orion — the two are never visible in the sky at the same time.

sagittarius.name: Archer Sector
sagittarius.description: The archer who shoots an arrow at the center of the Milky Way. The gateway to the galactic core.
sagittarius.mythology: The sky's reflection of the wise centaur Chiron.

capricornus.name: Sea-Goat Sector
capricornus.description: The gate of the winter solstice, an ancient mermaid-goat hybrid.
capricornus.mythology: The memory of Pan's escape from Typhon by turning into a fish tail.

aquarius.name: Water Bearer Sector
aquarius.description: The water bearer who pours water from the sky onto the earth.
aquarius.mythology: The place in the sky of Ganymede, the gods' water bearer.

pisces.name: Fish Sector
pisces.description: The modern gate of the spring equinox, the cosmic dance of two fish.
pisces.mythology: The moment Aphrodite and Eros escaped by turning into fish in the river.

pegasus.name: Winged Horse Sector
pegasus.description: The most distinctive sign of the autumn sky, with the Great Square.
pegasus.mythology: The legendary winged horse born from Medusa's blood.

andromeda.name: Chained Princess Sector
andromeda.description: Home to our nearest large galaxy (M31).
andromeda.mythology: The princess who was chained to the rocks and rescued from the sea monster.

lyra.name: Lyre Sector
lyra.description: The brightest corner of the Summer Triangle, shining with Vega.
lyra.mythology: The echo in the sky of Orpheus' enchanting lyre music.

aquila.name: Eagle Sector
aquila.description: The southern point of the Summer Triangle, shining with Altair.

canis_major.name: Great Dog Sector
canis_major.description: Home of Sirius, the brightest star in the sky.
canis_major.mythology: The faithful hunting dog of Orion the Hunter.

centaurus.name: Centaur Sector
centaurus.description: The brightest pair of the southern sky, with Alpha Centauri and Hadar.
centaurus.mythology: The wise centaur Chiron, the healer and teacher who rose among the stars.

crux.name: Southern Cross Sector
crux.description: The smallest yet most recognizable constellation in the sky.
crux.mythology: The sacred cross that points the way south.

phoenix.name: Phoenix Sector
phoenix.description: The sky home of the legendary bird born from fire.
phoenix.mythology: The immortal phoenix reborn from its ashes.

counter.title: Together Counter
counter.description: Every day you spend together is counted live right here. You can update your relationship dates from your Profile anytime.

shortcuts.title: Quick Shortcuts
shortcuts.description: The gallery, your journal, sealed letters and the meetup planner are all one tap away.

mood.title: Mood of the Day
mood.description: Choose how you feel today; let your partner know instantly and support each other.

menu.title: Menu & Guide
menu.description: All pages are in the menu. If you ever wonder what a page is for, just tap the ? button at the top right.

home.title: Home
home.summary: Your main control center where you keep a finger on your relationship's pulse, see your shared love score and enjoy the sweetest highlights of the day.

love_counter.title: Together Counter
love_counter.description: Every moment you spend together is precious! It counts the days, hours and minutes from your very first day until today, live, reminding you how much your relationship has grown.
love_counter.tip: You can update your relationship start date from the Settings tab anytime.

love_score.title: Dynamic Love Score & Meter
love_score.description: The love notes you leave in the app, the memories you share and your daily mood updates raise your shared love score. It is 100% equal and symmetrical for both partners.
love_score.tip: Leaving each other a little note or choosing your mood every day keeps your love score at its peak!

mood_selector.title: Mood Sharing
mood_selector.description: How is your day going? Happy, romantic, tired or blue... Pick your mood with one tap, let your partner know right away and support each other.
mood_selector.tip: When your partner feels tired or sad, sending a sweet message strengthens your relationship.

daily_note.title: Love Note & Quote of the Day
daily_note.description: Every new day begins with a romantic love quote, a piece of wise relationship advice or an inspiring saying made just for the two of you.
daily_note.tip: After reading the note of the day, you can talk about how it made each of you feel.

quick_cards.title: Countdowns & Letter Cards
quick_cards.description: From the home page cards you can instantly follow the time left until your next meetup and the status of sealed letters that aren't ready to open yet.

calendar.title: Love Calendar
calendar.tagline: The Two of You Within Time
calendar.summary: Your shared time capsule that keeps every special moment, feeling and plan you share, month by month.

calendar_view.title: Interactive Monthly Calendar
calendar_view.description: Browse all months and pick any day in the past or future to look through every note, photo and mood from that date.

colored_dots.title: Colored Day Dots
colored_dots.description: Colored dots appear under each day on the calendar: Purple (Love Note), Pink (Your Partner's Mood), Blue (Your Mood) and Green (Memory Photo).
colored_dots.tip: A colorful calendar is the loveliest proof of how many memories you've collected together!

add_note.title: Leaving a Note on a Day
add_note.description: Tap any day and press the 'Add Note' button to jot down an appointment, a movie plan, a doctor's visit or a sweet keepsake note for that day.

daily_summary.title: Daily Detail List
daily_summary.description: All events for the day you pick (who was in which mood, which notes were written, which photos were taken) are listed chronologically below.

letters.title: Sealed Letters
letters.tagline: Words of Love Sent to the Future
letters.summary: Surprise love letters you write today and seal for a special day in the future, which can't be opened until the time comes.

time_capsule.title: Time-Locked Letter Writing
time_capsule.description: Write what's in your heart to your partner and set the date and time it will open in the future! The letter is stored encrypted and can't be viewed by your partner until the time comes.
time_capsule.tip: You can seal motivating letters for anniversaries, birthdays, or the day before a tough exam or workday.

origami_ceremony.title: Seal Breaking & Origami Crane
origami_ceremony.description: When a letter is sent, it reaches your love on the flight of an origami crane. When the time comes, you experience the magical ceremony of breaking the wax seal to read the letter.

letter_vault.title: Received & Sent Letters
letter_vault.description: You can re-read the letters you've already opened as often as you like, and keep track of the time left on letters that are still locked.

tokens.title: Love Tokens
tokens.description: Use your tokens to send letters, or enjoy the freedom of writing unlimited letters with Premium membership.

photos.title: Shared Gallery
photos.summary: Your high-resolution, secure shared memory album that the two of you fill together.

shared_archive.title: Cloud Photo Archive
shared_archive.description: A shared memory gallery that never gets lost in your phone's storage and that only the two of you can access. The photos you upload appear on your partner's screen instantly.

exif_location.title: Smart EXIF & Location Detection
exif_location.description: When you upload a photo, the date, time and GPS location it was taken are detected automatically and synced with your map.
exif_location.tip: Even when you upload an old vacation photo, its original date and location are preserved!

fullscreen_stories.title: Full-Screen Memories & Stories
fullscreen_stories.description: Tap a photo to view it full screen and see the special caption below it, the city and the time it was taken.

map.title: Love Map
map.summary: The cities you've explored together, the cafés where you first met, and the secret love notes you leave on the map.

photo_pins.title: Photo Memory Pins
photo_pins.description: Geotagged photos you add to the gallery shine on the map as heart-framed pins at the coordinates where they were taken.

secret_notes.title: Leaving a Love Note on the Map
secret_notes.description: Long-press or tap anywhere on the map to leave a special love note for your love! Like 'We first hugged here' or 'The coffee here was so good'.
secret_notes.tip: You can leave a surprise note in advance at the place you'll meet next!

themes_filters.title: Romantic Themes & Filters
themes_filters.description: You can view your map in Romantic Pink, Midnight Dark or Nature mode, and filter to show only photos or only notes.

fit_bounds.title: See All Memories at a Glance
fit_bounds.description: Press the fit button at the top right and the map automatically zooms out to cover all your memories, wherever in the world they are.

medicine.title: Medicine & Health Tracking
medicine.tagline: You're Entrusted to Each Other's Health
medicine.summary: Daily vitamins, regular medication and health reminders. Look after each other's health with love.

dose_reminders.title: Timely Alarms & Reminders
dose_reminders.description: Set the times for your medicine or vitamins. When the time comes, sound and vibration local notifications make sure you never miss a dose.

partner_care.title: Partner Notifications & Tracking
partner_care.description: The alarm rings only for the owner of the medicine. You're notified when your partner takes their medicine; no notification is sent to your love about forgotten doses, but you can send them a sweet reminder yourself whenever you like.
partner_care.tip: Love also means caring for each other's health!

history_logs.title: Past Dose Records
history_logs.description: Build a regular habit by looking back at which days your medicine was taken and which days it wasn't.

period-tracker.title: Cycle & Period Tracking
period-tracker.summary: A women's cycle calendar with period and ovulation predictions. Designed so couples can understand each other better on sensitive days.

cycle_prediction.title: Smart Cycle & Phase Predictions
cycle_prediction.description: Based on your cycle length, your next period date, ovulation window and fertile days are calculated automatically.

symptoms_mood.title: Symptom & Mood Log
symptoms_mood.description: You can log cramps, headaches, fatigue or mood changes day by day.

partner_empathy.title: Partner Empathy & Support Guide
partner_empathy.description: Male partners see which phase their love is in and get notifications to offer a warm chocolate, a massage or extra tenderness on sensitive days.
partner_empathy.tip: A small gesture of care on hard days makes the whole world brighter.

meetings.title: Meetup Planner
meetings.tagline: Countdown to the Moment You Reunite
meetings.summary: Plan your next date with excitement, count down the seconds and immortalize your past meetups.

live_countdown.title: Live Meetup Countdown
live_countdown.description: A heartbeat counter that shows live how many days, hours and seconds are left until your meetup.

meeting_details.title: Meetup Location & Notes
meeting_details.description: Add the venue, the time and your preparation notes for that day to the shared list.
meeting_details.tip: You can pick a special spot on the map as your meeting point.

meeting_history.title: Past Meetups Journal
meeting_history.description: All your lovely meetups are kept as keepsakes, so you can see how often you get together.

memories.title: Special Days & Milestones
memories.tagline: The Turning Points of Your Love
memories.summary: The golden moments of your relationship, like the first time you said 'I love you', your first trip, the day you met and your anniversary.

milestone_cards.title: Relationship Milestones
milestone_cards.description: Add all the important events in your relationship with photos and descriptions. The time elapsed for each milestone is calculated automatically.

anniversary_reminders.title: Anniversary Reminders
anniversary_reminders.description: As special days approach, you get notifications in good time so you can prepare a surprise for your partner.
anniversary_reminders.tip: Never feel the stress of forgetting an anniversary!

daily-notes.title: Personal Journal
daily-notes.tagline: The Secret Sentences of Your Heart
daily-notes.summary: Your private journal that only you can see, stored encrypted.

encrypted_vault.title: Encrypted Notes
encrypted_vault.description: The feelings and notes you write in this journal are stored encrypted, and only you can see them in the app.
encrypted_vault.tip: Taking time for yourself and pouring your heart out will do your soul a world of good.

daily_reflection.title: Daily Reflection & Feelings
daily_reflection.description: Safely record how your day went, your goals and your personal reflections about your relationship.

profile.title: Profile & Settings
profile.tagline: Shape the App to Suit You
profile.summary: The control panel where you manage your theme, bottom menu tabs, security settings and couple connection.

tabbar_customizer.title: Customizing the Bottom Bar (Tabs)
tabbar_customizer.description: Choose the 5 tabs you use most! Place tabs like Medicine, Calendar, Map and Letters in your bottom menu in any order you like.
tabbar_customizer.tip: From the menu screen you can remove tabs you don't use from the bottom bar and put new ones in their place.

theme_options.title: Light / Dark & Pastel Color Themes
theme_options.description: Personalize the look of the app with an easy-on-the-eyes dark mode or romantic light theme options.

couple_connection.title: Couple Pairing & Account Security
couple_connection.description: Manage your partner's email, your relationship start date, password changes and device authorization settings from this screen.

reset_tours.title: Reviewing Tours & Guides
reset_tours.description: You can reset the page tours anytime, or go back through the explanations of all the features from the start.

If you don't renew by {{date}}, the star's coordinate is released and your memory planets wait in the vault for 90 days. If you renew, everything continues as it was.
alert.expiredBody: Because the subscription was not renewed, your star's coordinate was released, and since the vault period has also ended, full-size photos were deleted (small previews remain in the gallery). alert.vaultBody: Because the subscription was not renewed, your star's coordinate was released and its glow score and sparks were reset. Your memory planets and photos are safe in the vault until {{date}}: if you subscribe again and claim a star before then, your memory planets move to it unchanged. After that, full-size photos are permanently deleted; texts and small previews remain.
